final_draft.answer: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer word for word. It is backed by Access Control Policy section 4.2, which says all workforce members must sign in with a second factor and SMS is not accepted. The approved answer's owner is security@harborlight.example and it is valid until 2027-11-17. The answer comes from a written answer and policy, not a check of live systems. The question asks whether MFA is enforced. I could not check a live GitHub or AWS setting because no organisation name or AWS account ID was available. If the customer wants evidence from live systems, a reviewer could run github.org_two_factor or aws.root_mfa for the right organisation or account. Those checks would cover only GitHub and AWS, not the identity provider.
